description: This file is a JavaScript module that manages rendering and interaction for a web-based conversation viewer, including tree visualization, message rendering, session data handling, and user interface controls.

methods.name: downloadSessionJson
methods.description: Downloads the current session data as a JSONL file.

methods.name: buildShareUrl
methods.description: Constructs a shareable URL for a specific message entry.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard with visual feedback.

methods.name: forceTreeRerender
methods.description: Forces re-rendering of the conversation tree.

methods.name: navigateTo
methods.description: Navigates to a specific message or leaf in the conversation, updating the view.
